# The Part She Didn't Say

*A column by Marco Prestes.* I have known Lara Vento since she was a girl who corrected the spelling on our protest banners. Yesterday she spoke of work, of power, of the world. All true, all well said. I waited at the barrier for the part about the people who live where the pipe stops. It did not come. Maybe it is in the next speech. In Vila Tamarin we have waited a long time already. The kitchen opens at six, Madam President.
